# OrganoidOnChipInterface

**Domain**: Cross
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
A hybrid experimental-computational platform that couples living brain organoids with silicon-based readout/actuation arrays to study real-time topological dynamics. Enables direct validation of TCC/iNEST principles against living neural tissue, accelerating the transfer of biological topology insights into engineered systems.
